probe: affect_learned_gate_derisk (attempt 2, retry of the 2026-08-12 D1 gate-half failure)
verdict: BOUNDARY (6-seed, build-informative) -- tested 4 mechanistically-distinct candidate gates (arousal co-activation, habituation/frequency exclusion, cross-resample stability, neighbor affect-purity) plus the strongest 2-way combination, ALL calibrated then VALIDATED jointly across the full corpus + 6 independent 80%-bootstrap resamples (not just single-corpus fit -- a purity+magnitude config that looked FP=0 on the full corpus + 5/6 seeds failed at seed 42 during development, exactly the overfit the joint check exists to catch). BEST achieved: D_plus_B_combined at recall=0.294 (i.e. ~71% of genuinely affect-bearing words would be MISSED) -- below the 0.5 usability bar. The NAIVE negative control (thresholding the SAME learned-value magnitude DR-2 already computes) reproduces the named 2026-08-12 D1 failure quantitatively: no (Tv) achieves FP=0 at all, jointly across the full corpus + all seeds -- even giving up almost all recall does not buy back the neutral default. DIAGNOSIS: every candidate is a downstream read of the SAME co-occurrence/propagation graph, so all of them move TOGETHER on the confounded words (new/day/old/sit/look/cat/night/moon/garden/wonder score high on learned-magnitude, purity, AND frequency alike) -- this is a REGISTER confound (TinyStories frames ordinary actions inside emotionally-resolved scenes about as consistently as it uses real emotion words), not a threshold-tuning gap. Matches a documented limitation of label-propagation sentiment lexicons needing machinery beyond the propagated score to carry a neutral class (Hamilton, Clark, Leskovec & Jurafsky, EMNLP 2016, https://nlp.stanford.edu/pubs/hamilton2016inducing.pdf). The fixed Warriner threshold in affect_production_organ.py / wkv_mouth_generator.py is UNCHANGED (this file wires nothing).
